description: 192 kHz digital audio interface transmitter that encodes and sends audio data to the AES3, IEC60958, S/PDIF and EIAJ CP1201 standards over an on-chip differential line driver. It takes audio through a 3-wire serial audio port. Channel status and user data come in through an SPI/I2C control port (Software Mode) or through dedicated pins (Hardware/Stand-Alone Mode). It runs from a +3.3 V or +5.0 V digital supply (VD) and interface supply (VL).

groups.description: VD powers the digital core and VL powers the digital I/O and the AES3 line driver. Each runs from 3.14 to 5.25 V (typically 3.3 V or 5.0 V) and needs a 0.1 µF decoupling capacitor.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: A single GND pin is shared by the I/O and core logic.
groups.name: GROUND

groups.description: Control port pins used in I2C mode. SDA and SCL need pull-ups to VL, and AD0/AD1/AD2 set the chip address. These pins share functions with the SPI pins.
groups.name: I2C

groups.description: Control port pins used in SPI mode: CS (on AD0), CDIN (on AD1), CCLK (on SCL) and CDOUT (on SDA). A falling edge on AD0/CS selects SPI mode.
groups.name: SPI

groups.description: The 3-wire serial audio input (ILRCK, ISCLK, SDIN), the auxiliary AES3 input RXP, the user data input U, the channel status block sync TCBL, and the differential AES3 outputs TXP/TXN.
groups.name: AUDIO

groups.description: OMCK is the master clock input, at 128/256/384/512 × Fs.
groups.name: TIMING

groups.description: Reset (active low) and the Hardware/Software mode select pin H/S.
groups.name: CONTROL

groups.description: The INT interrupt output, with programmable polarity and output type.
groups.name: ALERT

groups.description: TEST and TSTN pins. TSTN must be tied to GND; TEST pins should be tied to VL or GND. Several of them take on Hardware Mode functions when H/S = VL.
groups.name: OTHER

pins.description: Serial control data I/O. In I2C mode this is SDA, an open-drain pin that needs an external pull-up resistor to VL. In SPI mode this is CDOUT, the control port's output data line.
pins.name: SDA/CDOUT

pins.description: Address bit 0 in I2C mode, or active-low chip select in SPI mode. A falling edge puts the device into SPI control port mode; with no falling edge the device defaults to I2C mode.
pins.name: AD0/~{CS}

pins.description: Address bit 2 for the I2C control port; tie to GND or VL. When SPI mode is used, connect it to GND or VL anyway.
pins.name: AD2

pins.description: Auxiliary AES3 receiver input for an alternate audio data source that is already AES3-coded.
pins.name: RXP

pins.description: Test input. Tie to GND for normal operation.
pins.name: TSTN

pins.description: Digital core power supply, typically +3.3 V or +5.0 V (3.14 to 5.25 V). Decouple with 0.1 µF to GND.
pins.name: VD

pins.description: Unused test input. Tie to VL or GND to minimize leakage; each TEST pin left floating adds about 25 µA from VL.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Unused test input. Tie to VL or GND to minimize leakage; each TEST pin left floating adds about 25 µA from VL.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Active-low reset. Holding it low puts the device in a low-power mode and resets all internal states. At power-up, hold it low until the supply and all input clocks are stable (minimum pulse width 200 µs).
pins.name: ~{RST}

pins.description: Unused test input in Software Mode. Tie to VL or GND.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Unused test input in Software Mode. Tie to VL or GND.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Serial audio input left/right (word rate) clock for the data on SDIN. It is an output when the serial port is master and an input when it is slave.
pins.name: ILRCK

pins.description: Serial audio bit clock for the data on SDIN. It is an output when the serial port is master and an input when it is slave.
pins.name: ISCLK

pins.description: Serial audio data input.
pins.name: SDIN

pins.description: Transmit channel status block start. As an output it is high during the first sub-frame of a channel status block. As an input, holding it high for at least 3 OMCK clocks makes the next sub-frame start a new block. Used to synchronize multiple CS8406 devices.
pins.name: TCBL

pins.description: Unused test input in Software Mode. Tie to VL or GND.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Unused test input in Software Mode. Tie to VL or GND.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Unused test input in Software Mode. Tie to VL or GND.
pins.name: TEST

pins.description: Interrupt output that flags events enabled by the interrupt mask registers. Its polarity and its type (standard or open-drain) are set in the control registers.
pins.name: INT

pins.description: Optional user data input for the AES3 transmitter. If it is not driven, use a 47 kΩ pull-down. If it is driven by a logic output, a 100 Ω series resistor is recommended.
pins.name: U

pins.description: Master clock input. It can be 128, 256, 384 or 512 × Fs (up to 98.4 MHz at 512×Fs). The ratio is set through the control port registers in Software Mode, or through HWCK[1:0] in Hardware Mode.
pins.name: OMCK

pins.description: Ground for the I/O and core logic.
pins.name: GND

pins.description: Logic (I/O) power supply, typically +3.3 V or +5.0 V (3.14 to 5.25 V). It also powers the TXP/TXN line driver. Decouple with 0.1 µF to GND.
pins.name: VL

pins.description: Hardware/Software mode select. Tie to GND for Software Mode (control through the SPI/I2C port) or to VL for Hardware Mode (dedicated pins).
pins.name: H/~{S}

pins.description: Differential line driver output, negative side, carrying the biphase-encoded AES3 data. Output resistance is about 26.5 Ω at VL=5 V and 33.5 Ω at VL=3.3 V. Pulled low while in reset.
pins.name: TXN

pins.description: Differential line driver output, positive side, carrying the biphase-encoded AES3 data. Output resistance is about 26.5 Ω at VL=5 V and 33.5 Ω at VL=3.3 V. Pulled low while in reset.
pins.name: TXP

pins.description: Address bit 1 in I2C mode, or the serial control data input (CDIN) in SPI mode.
pins.name: AD1/CDIN

pins.description: Control port clock: SCL in I2C mode (needs an external pull-up to VL, up to 100 kHz) or CCLK in SPI mode (up to 6 MHz).
pins.name: SCL/CCLK

variants.notes: 4.4 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch, JEDEC MO-153. C = commercial (-10 to +70 °C), D = automotive (-40 to +85 °C), R = tape and reel.
300 mil body, 1.27 mm pitch, JEDEC MS-013. Same pin assignment as the TSSOP.
